correctness.rationale: All geometric points partition by number of zero coordinates: one zero is outside the quintic, two zeros are Jacobian-smooth, at least three zeros constitute exactly twenty singular coordinate lines. On the torus the gradient is -P/x_i^2, forcing signed coordinates. The signed sum gives ten projective classes for all odd primes and an additional all-equal class precisely in characteristic three. The quadratic expansion on the hyperplane has only radial degeneracy and descends to a nondegenerate rank-four tangent cone for each isolated point. Disjoint support strata yield the exact all-extension point count. Replayed SymPy source confirms nonzero local Hessian determinants and the full prime-field singular censuses; finite experiments are not used for geometric completeness.

originality.rationale: Original singular-locus and ten-node classification applies to the classical characteristic-zero geometry; the arXiv:math/0010049 arithmetic smooth-reduction analysis expressly starts at primes at least five. The new contribution identifies and proves the extra characteristic-three node, a distinct symmetry orbit, its ordinary quadratic type, and exact all-extension singular-support counts. The characteristic-two diagonal singularity has a distinct local type, so its result does not imply this characteristic-three classification. Three directly relevant preprints were consulted at their substantive geometric sections; targeted online and indexed-record searches did not exhibit equivalent characteristic-three coverage. Historical priority remains provisional because the original 1994 article was not read in full and some specialized work might not be indexed.

value.rationale: The standard modular threefold has a genuinely exceptional odd bad reduction: an additional isolated ordinary node, fixed by full S6, appears alongside its natural twenty-line boundary and ten classical nodes. This supplies the complete reduced geometric singular support for every odd characteristic, a concrete boundary for integral specialization of the classical geometry, and exact all-extension counts for that support. The object is a distinguished modular Calabi–Yau threefold rather than an arbitrary coefficient slice; the result does not rely on claims of a global new resolution or cohomological downstream theorem.
